items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Henia, Frank Henia, was he around? [INTERVIEWEE] Frank Henia. Well I'll tell you a little bit. [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember him? [INTERVIEWEE] Well I was a musician by the right name, it's hard for me to tell.

ctx.x: Yeah. Henia, Frank Henia, was he around?
Frank Henia. Well I'll tell you a little bit.
